frontend_code_fingerprints.scope: Complete served style block; not container digest attestation.

native_checks: Project summary, rich description, paused status and both memberships match the browser edits.
One document and one milestone were created; milestone order matches the UI.
The existing document, all issues/comments/users and every unrelated captured collection are unchanged.
The single at-risk update contains the final mobile edit.
browser_checks: Desktop edit/save, document creation and milestone creation/reordering.
Post an at-risk update, edit it at 390px and reload.
Both widths visually inspected; mobile page width remains 390px.
limits: This is a bounded manual hosted flow, not full provider parity or an additional scored candidate rollout.
Successful exact-commit deployment plus served block fingerprints are not per-container digest attestation.
No complete pixel comparison or physical-touch/mobile device audit.
